topics.body:
# Marks

Each letter `a`-`z` holds one mark. Setting a mark records the focused app's pid and bundle identifier so jumps survive process restarts.

## Commands

```text
flash marks set a
flash marks jump a
```

If the original pid is gone, Flash relaunches the app from its bundle identifier.

## Optional mappings

Marks have no default NORMAL bindings. Choose explicit mappings in `flash.toml`:

```toml
[mode.normal.mappings]
"ma" = ["flash", "marks", "set", "a"]
"`a" = ["flash", "marks", "jump", "a"]
```

## Storage

The 26 lowercase slots persist to `Library/Application Support/Flash/Plugins/marks/share/marks.json`.
